name: Psychic Sensitivity
text: **Psychic Sensitivity**: The Darklands is full of strange energies, and the drow or half-drow who live there practice bloody rituals in exchange for favor and power. Drow or half-elves with this trait gain the Psychic Sensitivity feat (Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Occult Adventures 138), gaining access to occult skill unlocks normally only available to psychic spellcasters. This racial trait replaces keen senses for drow and half-elves and drow immunities for drow or elven immunities for half-elves.
